description:
FOUND s496a (Opus resume agent s499, 2026-09-27) from the Fable s499 review probes (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s499/review/p496-*.pl, outputs under out/: perl -> rv-base -> rv-s496a).  FILED, not fixed (Fable ruling s499).

All three from p496-userdef.pl (perl 5.40.3 vs the s496a tree 0ab64a45):

(1) EXCLUSION LINE:
  sub IsRangeMinus { "0030\t0039\n-0035\n" }
  "5" =~ /\p{IsRangeMinus}/  perl 0   tree died
  "6" =~ /\p{IsRangeMinus}/  perl 1   tree died
  perlunicode 'User-Defined Character Properties': a line '-hhhh' (or '-hhhh\thhhh') REMOVES that range from the set built so far.  The s496a parser handles +utf8::/-utf8::/!utf8::/&utf8:: includes but not a bare-hex exclusion.

(2) /i FOLDS A USER PROPERTY:
  sub InMyProp { "0061\t0063\n" }
  "B" =~ /(?i)\p{InMyProp}/  perl 0   tree 1
  perl calls the sub with a TRUE argument under /i and uses what it returns AS IS (the sub decides caseless membership); PCL wraps the resolved test in cl-ppcre's case-insensitive (or (test (char-downcase c)) (test (char-upcase c))).  Fix shape: call the sub with 1 under /i and exempt user-defined tests from the fold wrapper.

(3) PACKAGE SCOPING:
  package Foo; ... my $p = '\p{InMyProp}'; "b" =~ /$p/   (InMyProp is main's)  perl DIES 'Unknown user-defined property name \p{Foo::InMyProp}'   tree 1
  package main; my $p = '\p{IsFoo}'; "A" =~ /$p/     (IsFoo is Foo's)       perl DIES                                                  tree 1
  Cause: *pcl-scanner-cache* and *p-regex-op-cache* are keyed by pattern text + options, so the FIRST compile's package answer is reused from every package.  Fix shape: when a pattern names an UNQUALIFIED user-defined property (Is/In prefix, not a perl property), the key must carry the current package.  (s496a member 7 made qr compile eagerly, so a qr's property now resolves in the package current AT THE qr -- that half is right; the cache collision is this task.)

PART (1) FIXED in-batch (s496a member 7 follow-up, 2026-09-27): a `-hhhh` / `-hhhh<ws>hhhh` line now EXCLUDES the range (the eager qr compile made t/re/regexp_unicode_prop.t InConsonant/InGreekCapital die at the qr).  Guard regexp-subst-01.t row 48.  OPEN: part (2) /i folding of a user property, part (3) package-blind cache key (note: the per-name cache added in the same commit keys on the QUALIFIED name, so it is not the collision; the collision is *pcl-scanner-cache* / *p-regex-op-cache* keyed by pattern text).
subject: user-defined \p{IsFoo} properties, two gaps left (the `-hhhh` exclusion was fixed s496a): under /i PCL FOLDS a user-defined property where perl passes the flag to the sub and does not fold; and the lookup is PACKAGE-BLIND (the scanner cache is keyed by pattern text + options only)
